description: Named a TIME100 Climate Champion, Scott passed a first-in-the-nation law requiring large corporations to disclose their carbon emissions. Scott has taken on the giant corporate polluters and the status quo to protect Californians, and he’ll do the same in Congress. Scott also fights for public transportation and has played a key role saving Muni, BART, and Caltrain from devastating service cuts.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Wiener for Congress
title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Climate
